spec.actions: Select filters, Clear, apply.
spec.nav: Applies to the register list; Dashboard cards deep-link here with the filter set.
spec.permissions: Same site scoping as the register.
spec.interactions: Selections persist as removable chips on the list.

spec.actions: Open room, add room, connect rooms (managers).
spec.nav: Link button → Connect rooms sheet.
spec.permissions: Configure links: Super Admin, Admin, General/Area Manager. Staff view and allocate only.
spec.interactions: Group availability (fully / partially / none) shown on the badge.

spec.name: Connect rooms sheet
spec.purpose: Configure an interconnecting group (managers).
spec.layout: Sheet with property, searchable room checklist with free beds, rules note, save.
spec.data: Rooms of the property not already in a group, with free beds.
spec.actions: Select 2–6 rooms, Save, Remove connection (when editing).
spec.nav: Returns to the Room List.
spec.permissions: Super Admin, Admin, General Manager, Area Manager (enforced in app, API and database).
spec.interactions: Validation: same property, no duplicates, no room in two groups.

spec.name: SU allocation — room selection
spec.purpose: Place a resident (or family) in a room, showing interconnecting availability.
spec.layout: Resident summary, room picker with free beds and connected-room hints, family note.
spec.data: Rooms with at least one free bed; connected room numbers and their free beds; group availability.
spec.actions: Pick room, check in, repeat for other family members in connected rooms.
spec.nav: From New Arrivals or the register form; returns to the register.
spec.permissions: Create/edit on dailyRegisters; allocation rules unchanged (capacity, one active placement per port ref).
spec.interactions: Selecting a connected room offers "Place next family member here".

spec.name: Property Management — List
spec.purpose: Central master database for sites, properties, rooms, facilities, assets, and compliance.
spec.layout: Large-title navigation bar, optional segmented control, search field, status chips, then a card per record. Bottom tab bar stays visible.
spec.data: Each card shows the record title, subtitle and up to three facts. Source fields: Property ID, Property Name, Site / Location, Full Address, Property Type, Rooms Count, Bed Capacity, Occupied Spaces…
spec.actions: Add property. Open record, filter, search, swipe for quick actions (edit / archive where permitted). Page actions in the web app: view, create, edit, delete, export.
spec.nav: Tap card → Detail. Filter button → filter sheet. Plus → form (modal).
spec.permissions: Visible when the user can view "propertyManagement" (role rules plus any per-user Page Access override).
spec.interactions: Property list opens a profile with nine sections including rooms, assets and compliance. Swipe left for actions; pull down to sync; infinite scroll replaces desktop pagination.

spec.name: Property Management — Detail
spec.purpose: Read and act on one Property.
spec.layout: Inline navigation bar, summary card (avatar/initials, name, status, quick actions), grouped inset sections, attachments and history.
spec.data: All fields of the web record, grouped: Resident, Location, Classification, Case details.
spec.actions: Edit, share, overflow menu (archive, delete where permitted), open attachments, open audit trail.
spec.nav: Back to list; Edit → form; Attachments → viewer; Audit trail → timeline.
spec.permissions: Visible when the user can view "propertyManagement" (role rules plus any per-user Page Access override).
spec.interactions: Long-press a value to copy; tap phone/email to call/compose; share sheet for export.

spec.name: Property Management — Form
spec.purpose: Create or edit a Property.
spec.layout: Modal form: Cancel / title / Save, grouped sections (Resident, Location, Classification, Case details), evidence section.
spec.data: 10 fields from the web form (5 pickers, 0 dates).
spec.actions: Save, Cancel (confirm if edited), attach evidence.
spec.nav: Presented modally from the list or detail; Save returns to the record.
spec.permissions: Needs create/edit on "propertyManagement". Visible when the user can view "propertyManagement" (role rules plus any per-user Page Access override).
spec.interactions: Native pickers, keyboard avoidance with Next/Done, inline errors, draft kept on device.

spec.name: Property Management — Filter sheet
spec.purpose: Narrow the Property Management list without leaving it.
spec.layout: Medium bottom sheet over the list; grabber, grouped controls, Reset and primary apply button.
spec.data: Status values and site list from the same sources as the web filters; result count is live.
spec.actions: Apply, Reset, dismiss by swipe.
spec.nav: Sheet; returns to the list.
spec.permissions: Site choices are limited to the sites the signed-in role may see.
spec.interactions: Haptic on apply; selection count shown on the filter button.
